exclusions.reason: The current official non-degree international-student guide and official index confirm the same Tibetan Language non-degree identity already present in the formal catalog. The inaccessible image text was not split into invented programs.
The current 2026 international doctoral notice lists only Textile Science and Engineering and Design, both already present in the formal catalog; no semantic duplicates were emitted.
The current official guide exposes only Chinese Language and International Business master's offerings already present in the formal catalog.

The current 2026 program-list attachment is captcha-protected. Older English-program attachments were not promoted as current facts, and formal Civil Engineering and International Economics and Trade records were not duplicated.
The 2026 MBBS and general Clinical Medicine postgraduate identities are already represented in the formal catalog; no narrower research-field rows were emitted without independent program identity.
The accessible current international undergraduate guide did not yield a verified distinct program beyond the formal Clinical Medicine and Stomatology records.
The accessible official sources did not yield a cross-pack-distinct international program beyond the formal Physics, Materials Science and Engineering, and Chinese Language records.
No readable current official international-student program catalog was available; domestic admissions catalogs were excluded.
No cross-pack-distinct current international program was verified beyond the formal Law and Cross-Border E-Commerce records.
No cross-pack-distinct current program was emitted beyond the formal China International Business and Long-term Chinese Language records.
No cross-pack-distinct current program was emitted beyond the formal Chinese Law and Finance master's records.
No cross-pack-distinct current program was emitted beyond the formal Civil Engineering and Mathematics records.
No cross-pack-distinct current program was emitted beyond the formal International Trade and Anesthesiology bachelor records.
Domestic-student catalogs, department discipline lists without explicit international eligibility, third-party aggregators, inferred fees, and expired cycles shown as open were excluded.

notes: All candidate IDs and slugs are unique within this package; all evidence URLs are official HTTPS sources.
No program cycle is displayed as open because the 2026 language guide does not explicitly assign its December 31 spring deadline to a post-check intake.
The open scholarship cycle is Hainan Normal University's March 2027 International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship route, with an October 31, 2026 deadline.
All deadlines on or before 2026-08-04 are explicitly closed; undated routes are never displayed as open.
Hainan Medical University's additional programs use its official 2025 international catalog as historical identity evidence and do not claim a current open cycle.
Tibet University was not padded: its current official non-degree source confirms the same Tibetan Language identity already present in the formal catalog.

Five previously absent local strong universities were added with official international-admission evidence; Xinxiang is the only new city record because Haikou, Nanning, Lanzhou and Urumqi already exist.
